steps.title: Student Authentication
steps.description: Student authenticates and opens Course registration

steps.title: Select Owned Enrolment
steps.description: Student selects enrolment that has status history

steps.title: Enrolment History Panel Visible
steps.description: History section is shown for the selected enrolment

steps.title: History Row Visible
steps.description: At least one history row with status/action is visible

steps.title: History Status Field Visible
steps.description: History status value is rendered for the first row

steps.title: PostgreSQL History Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query verifies append-only history exists for the viewed enrolment
steps.query: SELECT status, action, actor_role FROM stu.enrolment_status_history WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND enrolment_id = 'a1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: API Gateway blocks unauthenticated GET to enrolment history with HTTP 401
